difficulty_reason: The author identifies the canonical linear system with the Veronese image of the double-cover pencil, using the sharp degree-2g−2 section bound, then recovers the pencil from the canonical image.
source_caveats: Uses §19.5 standing hypotheses (algebraically closed k, characteristic different from 2). The statement refers to the line bundle and hence to the pencil up to target coordinates. Exercise 19.2.A is standard Riemann–Roch/Serre duality and uses the adjacent author facts on degree-zero line bundles.
